verdict.rationale: YYLO Skills ships as a versioned skill bundle that teammates can each install from a shared GitHub repo. It offers interactive or prompt-free install-all via the `skills` CLI, a Claude plugin `marketplace.json` bundling all canonical skills, Cursor plugin metadata, and `yy skills install/update` for keeping agent copies on the latest stable release. Nothing in the evidence shows team-oriented distribution, such as committing skills into a project repo, pinning versions team-wide, or a lead curating and pushing a custom standard set. Missing for 10: project-committed or team-scoped install mode, team-wide version pinning or enforcement, a way for a lead to curate and distribute a custom skill set, independent corroboration of team rollout.
